custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders (List).
  2. Click Tech View in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar (tooltip "Tech View").
  3. Click Board View in the display switcher (tooltip "Board View").
  4. Click Tech View in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar (tooltip "Tech View"), then pick Compact density from its density button.
  5. In Board View's Fields to display (switch to Board View first), turn on Service advisor, Line count and Created date quickly, one after another.
  6. Leave the density as it is (Compact was picked in Tech View at step 4).
  7. Scroll a long column so more cards load.
  8. In DebugView, count each event name for this session.
